name: LTX 2.3 · 10Eros I2V · Shared lora library + CivitAI + scene continuation
description: LTX 2.3 I2V · shared lora library · CivitAI · audio

paragraphs: A ComfyUI backend on an fp8 mixed checkpoint, with the soundtrack generated jointly with the video rather than dubbed on afterwards.

A shared lora library that survives restarts. Every lora anyone adds is kept in a dataset bucket — name, trigger words and strength — split into two lists, ordinary and nsfw. Tick what you want and press one button: the links drop into the lora box and the trigger words are appended to the prompt, so a lora that needs xyztoken to do anything never silently does nothing. Paste a CivitAI or Hugging Face link and the title and trigger words are read off it for you. The list is common to everyone who opens the Space, and it is still there after it goes to sleep and wakes up again — nobody has to…

Unlimited custom lora. One per line: a Hugging Face repo (owner/repo), a repo with the file named (owner/repo:file.safetensors), a CivitAI download link, any other link to a .safetensors, or a file uploaded into the Space. The first thirteen lines get a strength slider; past that, write the strength on the line itself — owner/repo | 0.8, or | 0.8 | 0 to keep it out of the audio. A number on the line always wins over the slider. Press download / check lora first: the files are fetched outside GPU time, so the allowance is spent on the video.
